metadata.title: Fitness OS Phase 08 Seed Nutrient Taxonomy
metadata.notice: Stable nutrient and dietary-component identities only. Do not fabricate reference values, deficiency guidance or interactions.

groups.label: Energy and hydration
groups.description: Energy, water and alcohol-related dietary components.

groups.label: Macronutrients and major food components
groups.description: Protein, carbohydrate, fibre, sugars, fats, fatty-acid classes and cholesterol.

groups.label: Minerals and electrolytes
groups.description: Major minerals, trace elements and electrolytes with established or commonly used reference frameworks.

groups.label: Vitamins and vitamin forms
groups.description: Fat-soluble and water-soluble vitamins, including source-database forms and equivalent systems.

groups.label: Other essential nutrients
groups.description: Essential nutrients not grouped above, currently choline.

referenceFrameworks.label: US/Canada DRI
referenceFrameworks.notes: Age-, sex- and life-stage-specific values for generally healthy populations.

referenceFrameworks.label: FDA Daily Value - adults and children 4+
referenceFrameworks.notes: Single label reference value; not a personal RDA or AI.

referenceFrameworks.label: India ICMR-NIN RDA/EAR 2020
referenceFrameworks.notes: Preferred for Indian context when lawful structured use is confirmed.

referenceFrameworks.label: EFSA DRV
referenceFrameworks.notes: Professional population reference framework; not an individual prescription.

sourceRegistry.name: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements fact sheets
sourceRegistry.usage: Primary evidence summaries for functions, food sources, intake tables, safety and interactions.
sourceRegistry.rights: Link and summarize with attribution; do not reproduce large verbatim passages.

sourceRegistry.name: US/Canada Dietary Reference Intakes
sourceRegistry.authority: National Academies / NIH ODS DRI tables
sourceRegistry.usage: RDA, AI, EAR, UL, AMDR and related reference values for healthy populations.
sourceRegistry.rights: Use facts with source/version metadata; preserve value type and population.

sourceRegistry.name: FDA Daily Values
sourceRegistry.usage: Label-oriented %DV calculations; not a personalized requirement system.
sourceRegistry.rights: Public government information; cite version and intended label population.

sourceRegistry.name: Nutrient Requirements for Indians - RDA and EAR 2020
sourceRegistry.usage: Preferred Indian reference framework after content and redistribution-rights review.
sourceRegistry.rights: Do not scrape or bulk reproduce paid/copyright tables without confirmed permission.

sourceRegistry.name: EFSA Dietary Reference Values
sourceRegistry.usage: Comparative European DRV framework and scientific opinions.
sourceRegistry.rights: Cite opinions and framework; do not merge values with other authorities.

sourceRegistry.name: USDA FoodData Central
sourceRegistry.usage: Phase 07 food composition links and source-backed food rankings.

sourceRegistry.name: FDA Interactive Nutrition Facts Label education
sourceRegistry.usage: Qualitative food-label education only; separate from FDA Daily Value reference rows and personal needs.
sourceRegistry.rights: Brief original factual paraphrases with attribution; no source diagrams or bulk text copied.

sourceRegistry.name: FAO Food energy: methods of analysis and conversion factors
sourceRegistry.authority: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
sourceRegistry.usage: Documented energy units and carbohydrate measurement definitions; not personal intake targets.
sourceRegistry.rights: Brief original factual paraphrases with attribution; no tables or figures reproduced.

sourceRegistry.name: NHS water, drinks and hydration education
sourceRegistry.usage: General hydration education with source-age limitations, not individual fluid prescriptions.
sourceRegistry.rights: Text attribution under the NHS Open Government Licence policy; no third-party images copied.
